messages:
deploy-bot: Started staged rollout canary-2026-03-20 -> v2.3.1 at 5% traffic to eu-west-1. See /deploy logs: https://deploy.internal/r/canary-2026-03-20 :rocket:
sara: @kevin quick sanity — any known issues in this release? I skimmed release notes, nothing obvious but we got a small spike earlier today in auth service.
kevin: rollout looks clean from the infra side. model-serving changes are isolated to kv-cache eviction policy and a small kernel swap. I didn't expect auth impact.
anya: seeing a few 502s in EU from edge-proxy, not sure if correlated. throwing a quick query: `SELECT count(*) FROM requests WHERE region='eu' AND code>=500 AND ts > now()-5m;`
mike: @anya can you paste the query results? ops-sre, are you seeing alerts?
anya: result: 67 errors in last 5m vs baseline 3. They started ~2m after deploy-bot started rollout.
ops-sre: Yep we have an alert: eu-west surge 5xx rate 4.2% (threshold 1.0%). Investigating.
chris: logs show repeated `ERROR: backend-kvcache: failed to allocate cache shard` and `503 upstream read timeout`. Link: https://logs.internal/q/abcd1234
sara: ok. this looks correlated. proposal: hold the rollout and pin traffic back to previous version while we triage. + run a quick canary stop.
kevin: agree. I'm +1 to stop and pin. Any reason to roll forward?
ops-sre: no, there is a clear error signal. Recommend stop and rollback to v2.3.0 in eu regions.
sara: @deploy-bot please pause canary and pin routes to v2.3.0 for eu-west-1. Also notify customers in the EU change window channel.
deploy-bot: Received command: `/deploy pause --id=canary-2026-03-20`
deploy-bot: Pausing staged rollout... step=quiesce-5pct -> ACK
deploy-bot: Traffic pin: routing eu-west-1 -> v2.3.0. Rollback in progress: rollback-id rb-3478901112-1
kevin: running rollback script: ```./scripts/rollback.sh --region eu-west-1 --to v2.3.0 --id rb-3478901112-1```
kevin: rollback started, draining connections on v2.3.1 instances, reattaching LB targets to v2.3.0
anya: post-rollback tail: errors down to 1.1% after routing switch (20s after completion).
mike: trove of quicknotes for incident writeup: root cause looks like kv-cache allocation bug under certain eviction pressure when compiled with kernel-xopt-7. Suggest pinning kernel to xopt-6 until we can build a fix.
sara: good. let's capture: decision = STOP rollout, PIN eu-west to v2.3.0, ROLLBACK v2.3.1 in eu. Owner for fix = @kevin, ETA for patch build = 4h. Can we open a follow-up thread for release notes update?
kevin: will open PR to revert kernel selection and add integration test for cache pressure. tagging @chris for logs correlation.
ops-sre: I've updated the incident channel and escalated to infra on-call. Also added a temporary routing rule to prefer v2.3.0 for EU until we are sure.
sara: notify legal/comms for any customer-facing note? It's within change window but want transparency. @mike please draft a short bullet for status page.
mike: Will do. Draft: "We paused a staged rollout due to elevated 5xx rates in EU. Traffic has been pinned to the previous version while we investigate. No customer data impact expected." I'll post in 10m. :thumbsup:
chris: putting a quick dev task: `GH-4592 revert kernel-xopt-7 select when kv-cache enabled` and a test: simulate heavy cache churn.
kevin: starting patch build now. pushing artifact to staging. ETA ~3.5h for validated patch.
sara: thanks all. We'll reconvene for GO/NOGO once we have the patch and a short bake in staging. For now, thread closed for active rollout — leaving notes for postmortem.
deploy-bot: Rollback rb-3478901112-1 completed at 3478901178. All eu-west-1 traffic on v2.3.0.
